---
id: env.obl.tell-us-about-claims-and-pollution-conditions
type: obligation
heading: Tell Us About Claims and Pollution Conditions
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

You must tell us in writing as soon as reasonably practicable after you receive a claim, or after a member of your control group discovers a pollution condition that may give rise to a claim or to clean-up costs, and in any case within the policy period or the extended reporting period. You must send us copies of every demand, notice, order, direction or document you receive about it.

You must also tell any government authority about a pollution condition when environmental law requires you to.
